locations.name: Vault
locations.descr: A small, windowless stone vault. Dust motes swirl in the stale air. The only thing of interest is an oak chest in the corner.

items.name: chest
items.title: oak chest
items.descr: A sturdy oak chest with iron bands. Something about the lock looks off.
items.short_descr: A sturdy oak chest sits in the corner.

trap.descr: A poison needle is hidden in the chest's lock.
trap.llm_hint: The trap is a wounding prank, not a killer. Narrate the victim angry and hurt, not dead.
trap.effect_hint: On full effect the poison needle sinks deep into the opener's hand. On partial effect it only scratches. On a clean escape the opener jerks their hand back just in time.
